newsitem.title: UK: BA Credit Card sets escudo asset-backed deal. [CORRECTED 17/10 09:23 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BA Credit Card sets escudo asset-backed deal. [CORRECTED 17/10 09:23 GMT]

text.p: BA Credit Card Corp Ltd has launched a 7.5 billion escudo asset backed bond joint lead managers, Banco Finantia, Banco Cisf and Banco Mello de Investimentos said in a statement on Wednesday.
Salomon Brothers International is co-lead manager (corrects to clarfiy that Salomon Brothers is not joint lead manager).
The issue will be the first escudo securitization of a credit card portfolio managed by Bank of America NA, Salomon Brothers said.

The par-priced bonds will carry a coupon of three-month LISBOR plus 0.15 percent. They will have an expected maturity of seven years. The issue has a rating of A by Standard and Poors and A2 by Moody's. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7658
